meta.name: i-have-adhd
meta.description: Shape output for a reader with ADHD: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, make wins visible. Invoke with /i-have-adhd; stays on until "stop adhd mode".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让输出适配ADHD读者，突出行动项
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望AI回复更清晰易读，尤其是注意力不易集中时。
copy.tagline_en: Tailor output for ADHD readers: highlight next actions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI responses that are easier to follow, especially when you have attention difficulties.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 的回答会先给出具体可操作的下一步行动，用编号列出多步任务，每轮对话重新说明当前进度，避免跑题，给出具体时间估算，并明确展示已完成的工作。
howto.when: 当用户输入 /i-have-adhd 时触发，直到用户说 "stop adhd mode" 为止。

say.note: 开启 ADHD 友好模式。

say.text: 请用 ADHD 格式解释如何修复这个 Bug。
say.note: Claude 会以下一步行动开头，编号步骤。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude's responses lead with the next concrete action, number multi-step tasks, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, and make completed work visible.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user inputs /i-have-adhd, and stays active until the user says "stop adhd mode".

say_en.text: Explain how to fix this bug in ADHD format.
say_en.note: Claude will lead with action and number steps.
